name.description: Name of the underlying AnonCreds schema

version.description: Version of the underlying AnonCreds schema

supportRevocation.description: Whether the credential definition supports revocation

relatedJsonSchemaCredentialId.description: Verifiable Trust JSON Schema Credential that governs the credential definition

409.description: A credential definition already governs that JSON Schema Credential, or the registry of its issuer lists no AnonCreds schema for it yet

503.description: The JSON Schema Credential, or the registry of its issuer, cannot be reached
